about.title: About
about.whatIsDescription: WellBuilt Mobile is a companion app for oil field operations, helping drivers track tank levels, plan routes, and record pulls efficiently. It syncs with the WellBuilt Excel system via OneDrive for seamless data management.
about.builtByDescription: Designed and developed for the hardworking folks in the Bakken.
